title: Tetris
description: Falling blocks with controller and touch controls, hold, ghost pieces, and saved progress

screens.name: HELP
screens.title: Tetris controls
items: Turn the knob or tilt left/right to move. Held tilt repeats after 170 ms, every 60 ms.
Press to rotate clockwise. Tilt down for soft drop; tilt up once for hard drop.
Touch buttons also move, rotate, drop and hold. Hold is available once per piece. Rotate back turns counterclockwise.
Complete rows to clear them. Every 10 lines increases speed. Single / double / triple / four lines score 100 / 300 / 500 / 800 times your level. Soft drop scores 1 per cell; hard drop scores 2.
BACK or Pause returns to the menu and saves. Calls, popups and leaving the app pause play. Resume explicitly when ready. Parked only is on by default.

screens.name: NEW_GAME
screens.title: Start a new game?
items: Your current saved game will be replaced. Your best score is kept.
